standby_emergency.nearest_trauma_center: Regional Level-1 Trauma Center (<12 min EMS response)

hazards.hazard_description: High-acceleration robotic motion-control arm sweep and track pinch-point envelope.
engineering_controls: SIL-3 hardware E-stop lanyard at Video Village & Rig Base
Optical LiDAR/laser perimeter safety curtain interlock
Dry-run kinematic envelope sweep at 25% velocity prior to talent entry
hazards.notes: CSATF Bulletin #40 (Robotic Camera & Motion Control Safety).

hazards.hazard_description: High-draw DMX/HMI lighting distribution near wet set surfaces, condensation, or metallic truss.
engineering_controls: Class-A 5mA GFCI inline protection on all wet-area distribution drops
Elevated cable ramps, rubber matting, and bonded stage ground
IP65 weather-sealed DMX splitters & ballast isolation stands
hazards.notes: CSATF Bulletin #1 (General Safety) & CSATF Bulletin #22 (Electrical / Wet Location Safety).

hazards.hazard_description: Overhead truss/softbox rigging, tensioned wire/fabric loads, and elevated working-at-height perimeter.
engineering_controls: Secondary rated steel safety cables on all overhead fixtures & truss points
Certified load-cell shackles with 5:1 working load limit (WLL) safety factor
Tool-tether lanyards and barricaded drop-zone beneath riggers
hazards.notes: CSATF Bulletin #1 (Overhead Rigging / Fall Protection) & ANSI E1.6.
